comments.body: I come from a country where you can easily walk to someone’s house unannounced and simply sit in the garden for a coffee, biscuit and joint. After moving here my body felt tense of never being able to feel like I fit in. I started talking to myself as well and simply stopped going to events. At the end of the day, it’s better to be alone than with people that don’t want to be around you. Maybe try a dating App instead? OKCupid worked great for me
comments.author: littlemarmmot
